tweaks.title: Show file extensions
tweaks.description: Makes known file types display their extension in Explorer. Helps spot disguised files.

tweaks.title: Show hidden files
tweaks.description: Shows hidden files and folders in Explorer. Protected operating-system files stay hidden.

tweaks.title: Open Explorer at This PC
tweaks.description: File Explorer opens on This PC instead of Quick Access.

tweaks.title: Reduce menu show delay
tweaks.description: Lowers the delay before menus open from 400 ms to 20 ms.

tweaks.title: Turn off mouse acceleration
tweaks.description: Uses raw pointer movement without the pointer-acceleration curve. Changes how pointing feels; revert if you prefer the default.

tweaks.title: Enable Win32 long paths
tweaks.description: Allows applications that opt in to use paths longer than 260 characters. Microsoft-documented policy.

tweaks.title: Disable Windows consumer features
tweaks.description: Stops automatic installation of suggested apps and consumer content. Microsoft-documented policy.

tweaks.title: Disable Windows tips and suggestions
tweaks.description: Turns off Windows suggestion popups and soft landing content for the current user.

tweaks.title: Disable background game recording
tweaks.description: Turns off Game DVR background capture. Xbox Game Bar itself is not removed.

tweaks.title: Disable web suggestions in Start
tweaks.description: Stops Start menu search from sending the query to a web search provider.

tweaks.title: Disable the advertising ID
tweaks.description: Turns off the per-user advertising identifier used by Store apps.

tweaks.title: Disable app launch tracking
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from tracking which applications you start to personalize Start and search.

tweaks.title: Set Remote Registry to manual
tweaks.description: The Remote Registry service no longer starts automatically. Local registry access is unaffected.

tweaks.title: Set Fax service to manual
tweaks.description: The Fax service starts only when a fax-capable application requests it.

tweaks.title: Disable Windows Error Reporting
tweaks.description: Stops crash reports from being collected and queued for upload. Microsoft-documented policy.

tweaks.title: Disable LLMNR
tweaks.description: Turns off Link-Local Multicast Name Resolution, a name-resolution protocol that is commonly abused for credential relay. Domain environments may rely on it.

tweaks.title: Disable Remote Assistance invitations
tweaks.description: Blocks unsolicited Remote Assistance invitations. Other remote-support tools are not affected.

tweaks.title: Disable window transparency
tweaks.description: Turns off the acrylic/transparency effect for the current user.

tweaks.title: Disable window animations
tweaks.description: Removes minimize and maximize animations. Helps on slow machines and is often preferred for accessibility.

tweaks.title: Set processor boost mode to disabled
tweaks.description: Sets the documented power-management value that disables CPU boost. Reduces peak performance and heat; revert if you need maximum clocks.

tweaks.title: Disable fullscreen optimizations
tweaks.description: Makes games use exclusive fullscreen behavior instead of the fullscreen-optimization layer. Some games behave differently; revert if a title shows issues.

tweaks.title: Disable DWM animations
tweaks.description: Turns off window and Flip3D animations for the current user. A visual preference, not a performance guarantee.

tweaks.title: Set visual effects to best performance
tweaks.description: Selects the Windows 'Adjust for best performance' visual-effects set and writes each per-effect override used by the Performance Options dialog.

tweaks.title: Disable taskbar animations
tweaks.description: Stops taskbar button and preview animations. Revert restores the previous value.

tweaks.title: Disable list view shadows
tweaks.description: Removes drop shadows behind Explorer list items.

tweaks.title: Disable USB selective suspend
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from suspending idle USB devices. Can help with input dropouts; increases power use on battery.

tweaks.title: Disable power throttling
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from throttling background process power state. May reduce battery runtime.

tweaks.title: Prefer foreground processes
tweaks.description: Sets Win32PrioritySeparation to short, variable quanta with foreground boost. A scheduling preference, not a measured benchmark.

tweaks.title: Prioritize multimedia and games
tweaks.description: Sets System Responsiveness to 0 and disables network throttling for multimedia tasks. Affects scheduling and network behavior system-wide.

tweaks.title: Disable core parking on AC power
tweaks.description: Sets the minimum unparked cores to 100 percent on AC power. DC values are left unchanged. Revert restores the previous AC value.

tweaks.title: Disable recent document history
tweaks.description: Stops Explorer from recording recently opened documents in the jump list and recent items.

tweaks.title: Set fastest keyboard repeat
tweaks.description: Sets the shortest keyboard repeat delay and maximum repeat rate for the current user.

tweaks.title: Use the classic Alt+Tab switcher
tweaks.description: Shows the compact pre-Windows 10 Alt+Tab list instead of full-screen window thumbnails. Explorer must restart before the change is visible.

tweaks.title: Disable Aero Peek
tweaks.description: Turns off the desktop preview shown when the pointer rests on the Show desktop button.

tweaks.title: Delay taskbar previews
tweaks.description: Sets the taskbar thumbnail hover delay to a long value so previews no longer appear while the pointer merely crosses the taskbar.

tweaks.title: Remove menu and tooltip hover delays
tweaks.description: Removes the hover delay for menus and tooltips and lets background windows take the foreground. The focus value changes how Windows arbitrates window activation.

tweaks.title: Turn off Bing results in Start search
tweaks.description: Stops Start search from sending queries to Bing and turns off the Cortana consent value for the current user.

tweaks.title: Disable web search and Cortana policies
tweaks.description: Applies the machine policies that keep Start search local and turn off Cortana. The same policy set is used by managed Windows installations.

tweaks.title: Turn off local search history
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from keeping the list of previously searched items used by Start and search suggestions.

tweaks.title: Turn off Windows feedback prompts
tweaks.description: Applies the policy that stops Windows from showing feedback notifications for the device.

tweaks.title: Turn off Windows Ink Workspace
tweaks.description: Hides the pen workspace and its suggested-apps area. Pen input itself continues to work.

tweaks.title: Turn off the compatibility assistant and inventory
tweaks.description: Stops the Program Compatibility Assistant, application inventory and usage reporting. If an older application depends on an automatic compatibility fix, re-enable this tweak.

tweaks.title: Turn off most-frequently-used app tracking
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from tracking which applications are used most often for Start and search suggestions.

tweaks.title: Turn off cloud content suggestions
tweaks.description: Disables soft-landing content and Spotlight suggestions delivered through the cloud content policy path.

tweaks.title: Disable the Game Bar presence writer
tweaks.description: Stops the Game Bar presence server from activating. The Game Bar package is not removed; sign out or restart if the change does not appear immediately.

tweaks.title: Block Game DVR by policy
tweaks.description: Applies the machine policy that disallows Game DVR and broadcasting. Complements the per-user Game DVR tweak.

tweaks.title: Set optional Xbox services to Manual
tweaks.description: Sets the four optional Xbox services to Manual. They are not disabled and can still start on demand; revert restores each previous start type.

tweaks.title: Set diagnostic services to Manual
tweaks.description: Removes the automatic start of the Connected User Experiences and Telemetry service and the WAP push message service. The services are not stopped or disabled.

tweaks.title: Set telemetry to the lowest policy level
tweaks.description: Sets the diagnostic data policy to 0. Windows Pro may treat this as the minimum allowed level, while Enterprise and Education honor it fully; diagnostic events can still be generated locally.

tweaks.title: Turn off energy-estimation logging
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from logging per-application energy estimates used for diagnostic telemetry.

tweaks.title: Keep boot prefetching only
tweaks.description: Keeps prefetch data for boot and turns off application prefetch and superfetch behaviour. On fast SSDs the benefit is usually small; revert if applications start more slowly.

tweaks.title: Disable NTFS last-access timestamps
tweaks.description: Stops NTFS from updating the last-access time when a file is read. Some backup, indexing and forensic tools rely on this timestamp.

tweaks.title: Reduce delayed TCP acknowledgements
tweaks.description: Sets the global TCP acknowledgement defaults to acknowledge immediately and disable Nagle-style coalescing. This can lower latency for small packets while increasing packet count and CPU overhead.

tweaks.title: Tune AFD socket buffering
tweaks.description: Sets the community-established AFD send and receive thresholds and window sizes. These values are not covered by a Microsoft performance guarantee.

tweaks.title: Apply global TCP low-latency parameters
tweaks.description: Sets receive-window autotuning, receive-side coalescing, ECN, timestamps and selective-ack resilience through netsh. Every previous value is readable with netsh int tcp show global and is restored on revert.

tweaks.title: Extend the DNS cache lifetime
tweaks.description: Raises the maximum DNS cache lifetime to one day. After a DNS record changes, the old answer can persist until it expires or the cache is flushed.

tweaks.title: Remove the QoS best-effort reservation
tweaks.description: Removes the 80 percent best-effort limit used by the QoS packet scheduler. Modern Windows reserves bandwidth only when an application requests QoS, so the practical effect is usually small.

tweaks.title: Enable hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling
tweaks.description: Turns on GPU scheduling in the graphics driver. Requires a supported GPU and driver; revert if games or capture tools become unstable.

tweaks.title: Keep the system awake on AC power
tweaks.description: Stops the display, disk and sleep timers from turning the PC off while it is plugged in. Battery timers are left unchanged.

tweaks.title: Disable PCIe link power management
tweaks.description: Disables PCIe Active State Power Management on AC power. It can reduce NVMe and GPU wake latency at the cost of higher idle power.

tweaks.title: Raise the MMCSS Games task priority
tweaks.description: Raises the multimedia scheduler priority for the Games task class to 6. It changes scheduler preference, not a frame-rate guarantee.

tweaks.title: Request a high system timer resolution
tweaks.description: Requests a 0.5 ms timer through the multimedia and QoS profiles and enables global timer-resolution requests. The kernel value needs a restart and the setting increases idle power use.

tweaks.title: Disable telemetry and compatibility tasks
tweaks.description: Disables the telemetry, compatibility-appraiser and Customer Experience Improvement tasks listed in the operation summary. Each task's previous state is captured and restored on revert.

tweaks.title: Disable diagnostic maintenance tasks
tweaks.description: Disables background diagnostics and network trace collection tasks. Security, update and backup tasks are never targeted by this catalog.
